faqs.question: How long does payer enrollment take with Modio?
faqs.answer: Payer enrollment timelines vary by insurance company, but Modio typically completes commercial payer enrollment in 30-60 days, Medicare enrollment in 60-90 days, and Medicaid enrollment in 45-90 days. Their automation and follow-up processes help avoid common delays.

faqs.question: Does Modio handle CAQH attestation reminders?
faqs.answer: Yes, Modio automatically tracks CAQH attestation deadlines and sends reminders before the quarterly re-attestation is due. They can also complete attestation on your behalf if you grant them access to your CAQH ProView account.

faqs.question: Can Modio help mental health providers get on insurance panels?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Modio specializes in behavioral health payer enrollment, including psychiatrists, psychologists, LCSWs, LMFTs, and LPCs. They handle enrollment with major behavioral health networks, Medicare Part B, and Medicaid managed care organizations.

faqs.question: What information does Modio need to start the enrollment process?
faqs.answer: Modio requires basic provider information (licenses, DEA, NPI), practice details (tax ID, address, contact info), malpractice insurance certificates, and completed W-9. Their onboarding process guides you through gathering all required documentation.
